picker.currentEnd: Your plan ends on {{date}}. The new period is added after it, so you lose no days.
picker.empty: No Pro plans are on sale right now.
picker.note: You will be taken to the VNPAY gateway to pay by QR, ATM card or international card. The order is held for 15 minutes.

paid.title: You're now on Pro!
paid.body: {{plan}} is active until {{date}}. All Pro benefits are unlocked.

canceled.title: You canceled the payment
canceled.body: Your current plan has not changed.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.body: Your current plan has not changed.

expired.title: The payment session expired
expired.body: Orders are held for 15 minutes. Please pay again.

pending.title: Waiting for VNPAY to confirm
pending.body: This page updates itself when the result arrives. You can leave; your plan is activated as soon as VNPAY confirms.

invalid.title: Invalid payment result
invalid.body: This result could not be verified with VNPAY, so your plan has not changed. If your bank account was charged, check your payment history again in a few minutes.

missing.title: No payment result
missing.body: This page only receives results from VNPAY.

reason.07: The transaction was flagged as suspicious. Please contact support.
reason.09: The card or account is not registered for Internet Banking.
reason.10: Card details were entered wrongly more than 3 times.
reason.12: The card or account is locked.
reason.65: The account has exceeded its daily transaction limit.
reason.75: The paying bank is under maintenance.
reason.79: The payment password was entered wrongly too many times.
reason.other: VNPAY reported the payment as unsuccessful (code {{code}}).

errors.PRO_ALREADY_ACTIVE: Your account is already on Pro. You can extend it to add more time.
errors.PRO_NOT_ACTIVE: Your Pro plan has expired. Upgrade again; the new period starts today.
errors.PRO_PLAN_NOT_ON_SALE: This plan is no longer on sale. Please choose another.
errors.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Payment is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.default: Could not create the payment. Please try again.
